readings: Which broker reporting statuses (`brokrepstat`, with NULL treated as its own status) have an average `modelconf` above the overall average `modelconf`? That overall average is taken across all compliance cases with non-null `modelconf`, so each case counts equally. For each qualifying status, show the status, its average `modelconf`, and the difference between its average and the overall case-level average. Also show its average divided by the mean of the qualifying statuses' averages, which is the unweighted mean of those per-status averages. Ignore null `modelconf` values when averaging. Return nothing if the overall average cannot be computed. Do not round.

Which broker reporting statuses (`brokrepstat`, with NULL treated as its own status) have an average `modelconf` above the mean of all statuses' average `modelconf` values? That reference is the unweighted mean of the per-status averages, with each status counting once regardless of case count. For each qualifying status, show the status, its average `modelconf`, and the difference between its average and that mean of per-status averages. Also show its average divided by the mean of the qualifying statuses' averages, which is the unweighted mean of those per-status averages. Ignore null `modelconf` values when averaging. Return nothing if the reference value cannot be computed. Do not round.
queries:
WITH overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(modelconf) AS oavg FROM compliancecase WHERE modelconf IS NOT NULL
),
st AS (
  SELECT brokrepstat, AVG(modelconf) AS savg
  FROM compliancecase
  WHERE modelconf IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY brokrepstat
),
q AS (
  SELECT st.brokrepstat, st.savg, overall.oavg
  FROM st, overall
  WHERE overall.oavg IS NOT NULL AND st.savg > overall.oavg
)
SELECT brokrepstat,
       savg AS avg_modelconf,
       savg - oavg AS diff_from_overall,
       savg / (SELECT AVG(savg) FROM q) AS ratio_to_mean_of_qualifying
FROM q;
WITH s AS (
  SELECT brokrepstat, AVG(modelconf) AS avg_conf
  FROM compliancecase
  GROUP BY brokrepstat
  HAVING AVG(modelconf) IS NOT NULL
),
ref AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_conf) AS mean_all FROM s
),
q AS (
  SELECT s.brokrepstat, s.avg_conf, ref.mean_all
  FROM s, ref
  WHERE s.avg_conf > ref.mean_all
)
SELECT brokrepstat,
       avg_conf AS avg_modelconf,
       avg_conf - mean_all AS diff_from_mean,
       avg_conf / (SELECT AVG(avg_conf) FROM q) AS ratio_to_qualifying_mean
FROM q;
